## Source-verified outreach brief

### Lewis & Clark — San Diego admissions
- **Territory contact:** **Qwadere Lovell.** Lewis & Clark’s official California county-assignment table specifically maps **“San Diego — Qwadere Lovell.”**
- The same Admissions page gives the office contact: **admissions@lclark.edu** | **503-768-7040**.
- Evidence: [Lewis & Clark, Admissions—California](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/)

### Hunter Silberman — Fall 2026 MSW deadline
- **Application deadline: March 1, 2026. Supporting-document deadline: March 15, 2026.**
- These dates apply to the Fall **Two-Year Full-Time**, **Dual Degree—Bank Street (MSW & MsEd)**, **Advanced Standing**, and **One-Year Residency** programs. The school’s wording is: “Applicants are encouraged to complete their applications before or by the published deadlines”; an application submitted after a deadline “may not be reviewed for admission for the term to which you intended to apply.”
- Evidence: [Silberman School of Social Work—Deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

### IU Kokomo — graduate-program inventory
IU Kokomo describes its graduate offerings as including “master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate work.” I would treat named degrees/certificates—not their concentrations or tracks—as the programme set.

**Master’s degrees:**
- Master of Business Administration (MBA)
- Master of Science in Management
- Master of Science in Strategic Finance
- Master of Public Management
- Master of Science in Nursing
- Master of Arts in Mental Health Counseling
- Master of Arts in English
- Master of Arts in History
- Master of Arts in Political Science
- Master of Science in Criminal Justice and Public Safety
- Master of Science in Education in Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum
- Master of Science in Education in the Science of Reading
- Master of Science in Education in Educational Technology for Learning
- Master of Arts for Teachers in Mathematics
- Master of Liberal Studies

**Graduate certificates:**
- Alcohol and Drug Counseling
- Biology
- Business Analytics
- Chemistry
- Communication Studies
- Composition Studies
- Criminal Justice Leadership and Management
- Health Management
- History
- Leadership
- Literature
- Management in the Nonprofit Sector
- Mathematics
- Political Science
- Public Management

Useful official inspection points:
- [IU Kokomo—Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html) (the umbrella page; it explicitly identifies the three graduate-offering types)
- [IU Kokomo—Chemistry and Biology graduate certificates](https://kokomo.iu.edu/sciences/natural/graduate-certificates.html) (confirms those two certificates and says each is an 18-credit-hour programme)
- [IU degree catalogue search results for Kokomo master’s offerings](https://academics.iu.edu/degrees/)

### UCSF — currently open glioblastoma studies (Northern California)
UCSF’s glioblastoma index currently reports **“38 in progress, 16 open to eligible people.”** Two particularly direct options are:

1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — a Phase 1 study in **San Francisco** for adults. UCSF says it tests safety, side effects, and dose of E-SYNC CAR-T cells after lymphodepleting chemotherapy for EGFRvIII-positive glioblastoma. Principal investigator: **Jennifer Clarke, MD, MPH**.
   - Evidence: [UCSF trial page, NCT06186401](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06186401)

2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — UCSF expressly lists its San Francisco site as **“accepting new patients.”** It is a Phase 2 study for adults with newly diagnosed IDH-wildtype GBM, comparing DOC1021 + pIFN + standard of care with standard of care. Principal investigator: **Thomas Nelson, MD**.
   - Evidence: [UCSF trial page, NCT06805305](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06805305)

- Live UCSF index: [Glioblastoma clinical trials at UCSF](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma). Eligibility is protocol-specific; “open” is not an indication that a particular person qualifies.

### ORU — student activities / student-experience contact
- The relevant current ORU Student Association role is **Director of Student Experience: Augustine Mendoza**.
- **Email:** **augiemendoza@oru.edu**
- Official Student Association contact context: **7777 South Lewis Ave., Tulsa, OK 74171** | **(918) 495-6161**.
- ORU describes this team as the contact for questions including “events on campus,” shuttles, intramurals, and clubs—hence this is the most directly applicable student-activities contact rather than an inferred title.
- Evidence: [ORU Student Association Executive Team](https://oru.edu/current-students/my-campus-life/student-association/cabinet/index.php)

### EDF Energy — salary-review/increase position for graduate hires
- I found **no current EDF graduate-careers page that publishes a salary-review formula, timing, or guaranteed review process** for graduate-programme hires.
- EDF’s official **Early careers at EDF** graduate/placement brochure does make the narrower statement: **“You’ll receive annual increases, plus annual bonus, relocation allowances and other flexible benefits.”** That is the clearest EDF statement located on progression in pay; it promises annual increases, but does **not** state how those increases are decided or describe a distinct graduate salary-review policy.
- The brochure is labelled **2023–24**, so it is best treated as evidence of EDF’s stated policy in that brochure—not as a substitute for written confirmation of terms on a current offer.
- Evidence: [EDF Early Careers graduate/placement brochure (PDF)](https://www.edfenergy.com/sites/default/files/graduate_and_placement_brochure_2023_2024.pdf) and [EDF Graduate Careers](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers).
